# Alpine Hearing Protection

> > Alpine is the #1 hearing protection brand offering specialized earplugs and earmuffs for every situation, from sleeping and music to work and motorsports.

Alpine Hearing Protection provides innovative hearing protection solutions with hi-fi filters and noise-reduction technology across diverse use cases. The company, founded by Arthur van Keeken, designs products for sleep, music, kids, work, travel, motorsports, and water sports with a focus on sound quality and comfort.

## Product Collections

- [All Products](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/all): Complete product catalog of all Alpine hearing protection earplugs and earmuffs.
- [Earplugs](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/earplugs): Main earplug catalog featuring Tune, PartyPlug, Silence with hi-fi filters.
- [Earmuffs](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/earmuffs): Earmuffs collection: Muffy Baby, Muffy Kids, Defender, Formula 1 models.
- [Bestsellers](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/bestsellers): Alpine bestsellers collection: Tune, Silence, Muffy, SleepDeep earplugs.
- [Bundles](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/bundles): Discounted hearing protection bundles combining SleepDeep, Muffy, Tune products.

## Hearing Protection by Use Case

- [Sleep Earplugs](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/sleep): Sleep earplugs: SleepDeep, SleepSoft, Silence for noise-free rest.
- [Music & Gigs](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/music): Music earplugs: Tune, MusicSafe Pro, PartyPlug Pro with hi-fi sound preservation.
- [Kids & Babies](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/baby-kids): Kids hearing protection: Muffy Baby Comfort, Muffy Kids, Pluggies Kids.
- [Work & DIY](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/diy): Work earplugs: WorkSafe, Defender for DIY, construction, workplace safety.
- [Motorcycling](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/motor): Motorcycle earplugs: MotoSafe Race, Pro, Tour for wind noise reduction.
- [Racing Events](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/race): Racing protection: Formula 1 earplugs, MotoGP, Le Mans event gear.
- [Travel & Flying](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/travel): Travel earplugs: FlyFit pressure-regulating, Silence, Muffy for flights.
- [Swimming & Water Sports](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/swim): Swimming earplugs: WaterSafe Pro, SwimSafe, Pluggies Kids for water sports.
- [Focus & Concentration](https://www.alpinehearingprotection.com/collections/focus): Focus earplugs: Silence, Defender for concentration and noise reduction.
